Introduction
This document lists the inspection checks 
I1,
which must be performed every three months as indicated by 
M3
in the title block.
Safety Precautions
Charger must be isolated.
A work permit must be issued.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes goggles, and rubber glove.
Tools and Equipment
Digital DC voltmeter
Blower or vacuum cleaner.
Small screw driver.
Fine clothe.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the dirt
 and dust which accumulated.
Clean an
 insulating parts with a soft, dry linen cloth
Check

Check the earth

Check the
 prints are fully instead and properly fixed.
Check 
 auxiliary circuit connection on devices and terminal strips for tight fit
Check with the

Check the data
 measured referring to the battery charger data sheet:
 - AC Input
 Voltage 3x380V, Frequency 50HZ, Max current 25A
 -
 Float charge
 252V, Equalizing Charge 270V, Max Current 100A, Correct the
 adjustment. If necessary.
Check battery
 voltage and charging current in order to recognize any irregularity in the
 performale of battery and charger, correct the adjustment. If necessary.
Adjustment of
 current limiting:
 - The change is to be
 switched to Boost Change
 - The current is to be set to
 the rated value
 - The trim potentiometer
 r5 is to be toured into clockwise until the currant starts to
 respond.
Adjustment of

Adjustment of

Check the
